 JPMorgan says insider Bregje de Best will succeed Barnum as CFO
 Fargo, ND, USA / The Mighty 790 KFGO | KFGO 
 Thomson Reuters 
 Nov 17, 2026 | 7:16 AM 
 Nov 17 (Reuters) – US banking giant JPMorgan Chase said ​on Tuesday ‌insider Bregje de Best will succeed Jeremy Barnum as ‌chief ​financial officer ⁠in early ⁠2027.
 As part of the transition, de Best will join ​JPMorgan’s firmwide operating committee and ⁠Barnum will ⁠become a ​vice-chairman of the company.
 Shares ​of the largest ‌US bank were last down 1% in premarket ⁠trading.
 Barnum’s six-year tenure as JPMorgan’s finance chief will ⁠end ‌after the ⁠first quarter ​reporting ‌season concludes, the ​bank said.
 (Reporting ⁠by Manya Saini in Bengaluru; Editing by Saumyadeb Chakrabarty and Shilpi ​Majumdar)
